description: Finds the players who have not answered the next match on the USTA NorCal availability grid. Pass the team and the grid as your agent read it: each match column's header, and each player's row with one cell per column. It lists each player whose answer is blank or maybe, and writes one group message for the team with the deadline and the team grid link. Each line's win chance needs a Desk Pass after the member's free forecast each week. The Desk writes, and the captain sends every message from their own phone or email. Never send a text or an email yourself, and never read a teammate's phone or email. Call it when a captain asks who has not answered on NorCal, or wants reminder texts.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

columns.description: Each match column's header on the grid, as NorCal prints it, in order, for example #8 Sunday 10/18/26.

deadline.description: The answer deadline, as 2026-10-16 1:00 PM. Left out, 48 hours before the match starts.

format.description: The match format, as the NorCal post-dates form names it: All 3 or All 5 for one shift, or a split such as 2/1.

lineupNow.description: Set true to plan the lineup now, before the deadline, from the answers so far.

matchId.description: NorCal's own id for the match, from the Line-up link. Optional: it fills in the lineup form's path.

rows.description: One row for each player on the grid.

cells.description: One cell for each column, in order: the answer, won or lost once played, or empty when blank.

player.description: The player's name as the grid prints it, for example Able, Ann.

ustaPlayerId.description: The player's USTA player id, from the link on their name. It is matched before the name, and it tells two players with one name apart.

season.description: Season year. Defaults to the current season.

signAs.description: The captain's first name, which signs the lineup email.

team.description: The team the grid is for: the Desk's team id, which is NorCal's own team id, a link to its team page, or its name. Left out, the signed-in member's own team this season.

name: availability_loop
title: Chase who hasn't answered
